title: Portsmouth drinks from Europe's biggest spring source

lines.text: Europe's biggest spring water source may be near Portsmouth.
Portsmouth Water says the Havant and Bedhampton springs are thought to be the largest in Europe.
Rain soaks into the chalk, then bursts out right here.
Together they flow at about a hundred and four thousand cubic metres a day.
That's enough to fill forty Olympic pools, every day.
They provide thirty per cent of Portsmouth Water's supply.
Spare winter water flows out to sea, so a new reservoir at Havant Thicket will store up to eight point seven billion litres.
River, reservoir, or spring: where's yours from? Comment your guess.
